thread:
tom: @here Heads-up: next Fri (Apr 24) we'll cut over GitHub org SSO from legacy SAML to the new Okta SCIM+OIDC flow. Expected short maintenance: 15m of redirects for repo ACLs. Please review runbook if you own repos or Actions.

rachel: does this impact self-hosted runners or repo actions tokens?

tom: self-hosted runners keep existing runner tokens. However, any Actions workflows that use PATs scoped to teams may be affected if team slugs change. We're preserving slugs where possible.

jess: will the GitHub Apps we own need re-authorization? Our CI App uses org-level permissions.

tom: most apps keep permissions. We'll re-install apps in staging and run smoke tests. If re-auth is required we'll DM the app owners before cutover.

paul: can devops-bot kick off a dry-run and publish delta of repo permission changes?

devops-bot: auto:dry-run started 1768300600. Dry-run report: https://artifacts.redwood/identity/gh-sso-dryrun-1768300600.csv :white_check_mark:

rachel: runbook link? want to coordinate with infra on Monday.

tom: runbook: https://git.redwood/ops/identity/gh-sso-cutover.md — includes smoke tests and rollback steps. Quick rollback command in runbook: `./gh-sso-cutover --undo --from snap-1768300500`.

jess: office hours before the cutover?

tom: scheduled Thu 16:00 PT. Invite sent.

paul: note for CI owners: check any hardcoded team slugs in workflows and CODEOWNERS. We'll open an automation PR for repos that opt-in.

drdev-bot: reminder: backup snapshot saved s3://redwood-identity/backups/snap-1768300550.json

tom: thanks all. Please add exceptions to the cutover spreadsheet by EOD Tue. We'll post final timeline after the staging verification.
